titulo_es: A change in the recipe · Recipes and allergens

texto: The recipes usually express instructions with imperative and amounts with units. On a label, look for «indeholder» (contains) and «kan indeholde» (may contain): they do not express the same degree of certainty.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.es: Usamos leche de avena en lugar de leche de vaca.
frases.en: We use oatmilk instead of cow's milk.

frases.da: Derfor passer kagen til flere gæster.
frases.es: Por eso el pastel es apto para más invitados.
frases.en: That's why the cake is suitable for more guests.
